item.title: Projection Mapped Face Sculpture for Festival Stages
item.description: Software turned the 3D mesh into a series of interlocking pieces of wood, laser cut and slotted together. This was a small scale prototype. The build process of two video projection mapped face sculptures, designed, built, animated and mapped for music festival visual shows. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.
